FREE EXCHANGES On sized items (socks excluded) OFFICIALLY LICENSED Description St. John’s debuted this logo in 1994, depicting the (literal) Red Storm making its way over New York City, alongside a red mustang mascot they used through the mid-2000’s. In 2009, though, the school selected a new mascot that better suited the Red Storm name – Johnny Thunderbird, a costumed bird mascot that appears at athletic events. Products are mocked up on a size S. Graphics may appear smaller on larger sizes. STJ-T-002-XS Sizing Our unisex tees run true to size. If you're looking for a roomier fit, we suggest sizing up!
